page.overview:
Who is The Swordsman?

The Swordsman was the titular character of the radio play.

The Swordsman was a lone warrior who wandered the Known Universe fighting for truth and justice. He travelled to Amarynth III after defeating Hyrenzir on the plains of Jericha. He learned from a young boy that his village was enslaved by Lord Varek due to the fall of House Wayku and the abandonment of the planet by the Spacing Guild. The Swordsman confronted Varek, whose guards attacked and manouvered him onto a trapdoor. In the pit, he met Rodrigo and his daughter Gina, who helped him escape. He forged a new sword and trained the villagers, inspiring them to rise in revolt against Varek. The Swordsman killed Varek and the villagers defeated his followers, but Rodrigo was killed. The Swordsman assured Gina that her father did not die in vain and instructed her to help the villagers endure until the Spacing Guild returned for them before departing.
